fields.title: Severe Flooding - Immediate Evacuation Required
fields.description: Heavy rainfall has caused severe flooding in Wayanad district. Low-lying areas near Kabini River are at high risk. Residents are advised to evacuate immediately to designated relief camps.

fields.title: Landslide Warning - Hill Areas
fields.description: Continuous heavy rainfall has triggered multiple landslides in hilly regions of Idukki. Tourists and residents in mountainous areas should stay alert and avoid travel.

fields.title: Flood Relief Camp Established
fields.description: Relief camp operational at Alappuzha Municipal Town Hall for flood-affected families. Medical aid, food, and shelter available. Contact: 0477-2253334

fields.title: Water Level Rising - Stay Alert
fields.description: Water levels in Meenachil River rising due to dam release. Residents along riverbanks advised to stay alert and move to higher ground if necessary.

fields.title: Cyclone Alert - Coastal Areas
fields.description: Cyclonic storm approaching Kerala coast. Fishermen advised not to venture into sea. Coastal residents should take necessary precautions.
